output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(readr)
troyDat <- read_csv("~/Downloads/troyDat.csv")
View(troyDat)
```

##Adding a location to the subject
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
troyDat$location <- "University of Minnesota"
```

##Adding a subject number to each participants' response
```{r}
troyDat$subj <- (1:56)
```

```{r}
troyDatNew <- troyDat %>%  relocate(subj, .before = age)
```

##Putting family income on a 1-12 scale
```{r}
library(dplyr)

troyDatNew <- troyDatNew |>
  mutate(
    famIncome = case_match(
      familyIncome,
      "$10,000 or below"    ~ 1,
      "$10,001-$20,000"   ~ 2,
      "$20,001-$30,000"   ~ 3,
      "$30,001-$40,000"   ~ 4,
      "$40,001-$50,000"   ~ 5,
      "$50,001-$60,000"   ~ 6,
      "$60,001-$70,000"   ~ 7,
      "$70,001-$80,000"   ~ 8,
      "$80,001-$90,000"   ~ 9,
      "$90,001-$100,000"  ~ 10,
      "$100,001-$200,000" ~ 11,
      "Above $200,000"      ~ 12
    )
  )
```
